selection.name: decode attention dual-form matmul sequence
selection.scope: A complete host-orchestrated decode-attention step on RK3588: explicit KV append/view materialization, GQA head mapping, QK^T, numerically stable FP32 softmax, FP16 probability carrier, PV, and final FP16 output for both SWA and full attention. CPU scalar/NEON complete-sequence baselines are compared with a core0 RKNPU-matmul plus A76-softmax hybrid; isolated OPE2 matmul cells are not repeated as the deliverable.

A_authenticity.evidence: The frozen population is the observed 21,694 decode forwards: 35 SWA layer calls per forward at L=512,D=256 and 7 full-attention calls per forward at D=512,L=807..7359, totaling 759,290 plus 151,858 = 911,148 attention invocations. The 8Q/2KV, group-size-4, scale-1.0, FP32-softmax contract is inherited from the verified K3 lineage.
A_authenticity.limit: Input tensors and the carrier are synthetic and isolated. The host sequence reproduces mathematical, KV-layout, masking, and scheduling semantics; it is not the closed RKLLM attention implementation and does not assert its internal dtype or layout.

B_bottleneck.evidence: OPE2 measures isolated rknn_matmul_run cells, while OPE4 exposes only whole decode generation and no separable attention timer. A complete attention step supplies the missing nonlinear/layout/orchestration counterfactual and can be placed beside the 446.126261 ms/token OPE4 anchor without subtracting it.
B_bottleneck.limit: The isolated sequence time is not an RKLLM component measurement, does not apportion the OPE4 gap, and cannot be subtracted from TPOT or converted into a deployment-speed claim.

C_capability.evidence: The captured board header exposes RKNN_FLOAT16_MM_FLOAT16_TO_FLOAT32; OPE2 established core0 as runnable under runtime 2.3.2. Its 108 attention terminals are all N/A_OPE5_STANDBY with zero attempts, so they are reservation records rather than capability failures. FP16 alignment is satisfied by explicit QK N-padding to 16 and PV K-padding to 32.
C_capability.limit: Grouped M=4 QK/PV is not claimed proven before execution. The only formal segment must run capability and correctness gates before timing; any rejection or mismatch invalidates the segment and is retained without fallback to per-head OPE2 replay, another dtype, or a second segment.

D_deliverability.evidence: One report can deliver complete-sequence latency for scalar CPU, NEON CPU, and hybrid core0-RKNPU paths, split by SWA/full and combined with the observed invocation weights. The timed boundary includes KV append/view, padding/packing, both matmuls, softmax, probability conversion, and output conversion.
D_deliverability.limit: No RKLLM patch, model reconnection, quality test, prefill result, multi-core NPU result, energy claim, or hardware-leaderboard claim is in scope. PC K3 performance is semantic context only and is never mixed into the board score.

distinct_sequence_carrier.name: hybrid_gqa_decode_step_v1
why_distinct_from_ope2: executes QK^T then FP32 softmax then PV as one timed attention step
maintains explicit SWA ring and full-prefix KV state and includes append/view materialization
maps query heads 0..3 to KV head 0 and 4..7 to KV head 1 without materialized repeat-KV
masks QK padding and zeros PV padding
reports sequence-level SWA/full and invocation-weighted results rather than isolated matmul cells

cpu7_a76: KV state update and active-window selection
FP32-to-FP16 probability conversion and final FP16 output conversion
rknpu_core0: two grouped QK matmuls, one for each KV head
two grouped PV matmuls, one for each KV head

distinct_sequence_carrier.timed_boundary: Starts immediately before appending the new K/V token and ends after contiguous FP16 [8,D] output is produced. Deterministic corpus construction, context creation, buffer allocation, and one-time native-layout plan construction are outside; all per-step data movement, transpose/packing, memset, set_io, run, softmax, and conversion are inside.

primary_choice_rationale.selected: complete hybrid sequence with grouped GQA matmuls

rejected_shortcuts.repeat_ope2_single_matmul_grid: Does not cover softmax, KV state/layout, GQA mapping, or orchestration.
rejected_shortcuts.cpu_only_attention: Useful as baselines but does not exercise the board NPU sequence path selected by the board execution card.
rejected_shortcuts.rkllm_reconnection: Closed-runtime internal replacement is unavailable and PC K3 reconnection failed its token hard gate; this stage is explicitly isolated.
rejected_shortcuts.physical_repeat_kv: Would add unauthentic 2-to-8 KV replication and erase the central GQA layout property.

decision.next_action: Freeze and independently verify ope5_attention_sequence_prereg.json. Only after PASS may the three complete-sequence implementations be written and source-locked.
decision.no_automatic_fallback: Repair implementation defects inside the frozen carrier before source-lock. After source-lock, a formal capability/correctness failure closes the segment; do not replace grouped M=4 with per-head replay, change dtype, drop full or SWA, omit layout work, or run another segment.

claim_limits: The board carrier uses FP16 storage because the board matmul API exposes FP16-to-FP32; it is lineage-separated from the PC BF16 K3 carrier and from unknown RKLLM internals.
The sequence result is an isolated counterfactual and not an attention timer from OPE4.
The PC K3 isolated speedup and failed model reconnection are context only; neither is a board baseline.
Only one future formal segment is allowed: no performance smoke, automatic retry, same-day retest, or replication claim.
This scope stage performs no board connection, implementation, source lock, capability run, correctness run, or timing.
